title: BE STILL
KNOW GOD
end: The Midday Watch — pause and pray at noon
stock_queries: golden midday sunlight on a wooden desk
dust motes dancing in shaft of light
shadows stretching across a quiet floor
sunlight reflecting on a glass of water
blurred green leaves in bright daylight

scenes.a: That sharp anxiety over your pending deadline has occupied your mind long enough this morning.
Release the grip of your own effort and hear the voice of the eternal King today.
Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.
Lord, teach me to trade this restless striving for the perfect peace of your presence.
Calm my racing thoughts so that I might perceive your sovereign hand in every detail.
May your glory be the only thing that matters in my work and my rest.
